scripts.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && uv --directory backend sync --frozen && uv --directory fetcher sync --frozen && uv --directory backend run pre-commit install --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type pre-push
scripts.dev:backend: uv --directory backend run python scripts/dev.py up-server
scripts.test: pnpm test:dashboard && pnpm test:backend && pnpm test:fetcher
scripts.test:backend: uv --directory backend run python scripts/dev.py test-db
scripts.format: pnpm format:dashboard && pnpm format:backend && pnpm format:fetcher
scripts.format:backend: uv --directory backend run ruff check --fix app tests scripts migrations && uv --directory backend run black app tests scripts migrations
scripts.format:fetcher: uv --directory fetcher run ruff check --fix . && uv --directory fetcher run black .
scripts.check: pnpm check:dashboard && pnpm check:backend && pnpm check:fetcher && pnpm build:dashboard
scripts.check:dashboard: pnpm --filter dashboard format:check && pnpm --filter dashboard lint:check && pnpm --filter dashboard type:check && pnpm --filter dashboard test
scripts.check:backend: uv --directory backend run ruff check app tests scripts migrations && uv --directory backend run black --check app tests scripts migrations && uv --directory backend run mypy app
scripts.check:fetcher: uv --directory fetcher run ruff check . && uv --directory fetcher run black --check . && uv --directory fetcher run pytest
scripts.hook:pre-commit: uv --directory backend run pre-commit run --hook-stage pre-commit
scripts.hook:pre-push: uv --directory backend run pre-commit run --hook-stage pre-push
